notes: Closed named OSM raceway retained as a course candidate. Named-layout association requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 42 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Sparse observations on pinned licensed satellite imagery: outside edge follows the track-side wall; inside follows front-straight grass/paint edge and the visible oval-to-apron paint or surface transition elsewhere. Faint paint, access openings and intervals between observations are interpolated unverified limits, not a surveyed racing boundary. The wider apron and pit roads are outside this selected oval ribbon. Banking is not resolved by the terrain raster.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
